thread:
kevin: Quick heads-up — saw an eviction spike for cohort-A in the latest microbenchmark run (node pool: bench-small). Batch size was set to 8 for the tiny-batch experiment. Anyone else see this? :eyes:
sasha: saw similar in sample trace. hit rate dropped ~12% after ~6m into the run, evictions surged. I grabbed a heap dump and a KV occupancy snapshot.
james: can you paste the occupancy snapshot? curious if fragmentation or TTL churn.
kevin: attaching snippet from the snapshot (trimmed):
```
kv_slots_total: 32768
kv_slots_used: 29890
slot_frag_ratio: 0.21
prefix_count_cohortA: 12345
evictions_1m: 4.2k
median_kv_ttl: 18s
```
rachel: median_ttl 18s seems low — are we running synthetic requests with short-lived prefixes? also did the model prompts change?
sasha: test harness used same prompt distribution as baseline. only change was batch_size=8 and enable_prefix_prefetch=true in the config.
james: enable_prefix_prefetch can increase live set size if prefetch horizon not bounded. If prefetch pulls in long tails, fragmentation can look worse. Can we repro with prefetch off?
kevin: repro command I used locally:
```
./bench/run_micro --cohort A --concurrency 64 --batch-size 8 --duration 10m --enable-prefetch
```
ci-bot: perf-run/1912345672 completed — 10m, 64c, batch=8
ci-bot: summary: avg latency 74ms, p95 230ms, tokens/sec -12% vs baseline, eviction-rate +3.8k/min
rachel: can you run with `--enable-prefetch=false` and batch=8? if hitrate recovers it's prefetch.
sasha: I'll spin a run now (queued). Also going to capture kv-fragmentation histogram and per-slot age.
james: if fragmentation is the cause, we should test enabling the slot-compaction tweak I landed last week (`kv.compact_on_eviction=true`) — it reduces slot holes at cost of CPU.
kevin: ok running two quick variants: (A) batch=8 + prefetch=true, (B) batch=8 + prefetch=false, (C) batch=8 + prefetch=true + compact_on_eviction=true. will post results.
sasha: FYI, I noticed the eviction victims are biased to high-prefix-length keys — could be prefetch pulling long prefixes that pollute hotset.
kevin: run A (prefetch=true): eviction-rate 4.1k/min, hitrate -11.8% (matches previous)
kevin: run B (prefetch=false): eviction-rate 400/min, hitrate -1.2% (much better)
kevin: run C (prefetch=true + compact): eviction-rate 1.1k/min, hitrate -4.5%
james: nice — that triangulates prefetch as main vector, compaction helps but doesn't fully close gap.
rachel: for next steps: 1) limit prefetch horizon for cohort-A, 2) consider enabling compact_on_eviction for small nodes, 3) add a microbenchmark test that toggles prefetch in CI so regressions are caught.
sasha: creating a tiny follow-up PR to clamp prefetch to 10 prefixes by default for bench pools. will add a perf test too. @kevin can you add the KV snapshots and logs to the issue?
kevin: done — uploaded heap + occupancy + perf logs to the ticket: https://redwood/issue/INF-4821
james: also let's add a short note for ops: if you see hit-rate drop with prefetch enabled, consider toggling compact_on_eviction as emergency mitigation.
kevin: thanks all. closing the loop here — creating a rollout checklist for the prefetch clamp. :white_check_mark:
sasha: thanks — will monitor next nightly run and post results.
